name: Pessimist Hell/Paradise
source:
What? You want to know about the game? Why? You're not going to play it, are you?

Don't you have better things to do? You're really going to waste your time playing a slice-of-life visual novel about a teen struggling to overcome their pessimistic and anxious mind? You must think it'll go well. You must think you'll have fun, or worse yet--achieve one of the happy endings. Ugh, I don't know what would make you think that. 

But... if you're in the mood for a bad time, be my guest. This'll be your Pessimist Paradise. 

[From [url=https://charitydoesgames.itch.io/pessimist-hellparadise]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
什么？你想了解这款游戏？为什么？你又不会真的去玩，对吧？

你就没有更值得做的事吗？你真要把时间浪费在一部日常题材的视觉小说上，看一个青少年努力摆脱悲观与焦虑的心态？你一定觉得事情会顺利。一定觉得自己能玩得开心，甚至更离谱——你还想达成某个幸福结局。唉，真不知道你哪来的这种想法。

不过……如果你就是想找罪受，那就请便吧。这里会是你的悲观者乐园。

[摘自[url=https://charitydoesgames.itch.io/pessimist-hellparadise]itch.io[/url]]
